entry_points.text: Paranoid entry preserves regs, switches address space and segments, applies mitigations; fault entry splits by CS privilege to sync path or kernel classifier; return asserts IRQs off.
NMI from user swaps base, switches stack, copies five-slot frame and returns without exit work; ignore target reports not-implemented; BHB loop runs nested calls then fence.
Compat entries disable IRQs, swap base, switch tables/stack, build save area, sanitize flags, clear BHB and dispatch 32-bit; legacy and FRED variants narrow AX and exit via shared path.
FRED user and kernel entries share prologue, call type-specific C dispatcher, run epilogue and return; KVM builds synthetic frame on task stack and handles only external and NMI.

exports.text: Dispatch uses tables indexed by number with decl, nonreturn and case forms; compat selector picks native or compat symbol, populated from generated lists, miss falls back to not-implemented.
User-mapped services delegate time, clock, resolution, cpu, random and robust unlock in 32 and 64 bit widths; linker script groups them under version nodes and hides the rest.

hazards.text: Mispredicted base loads, stale BHB and buffers, NMI races, single-step, segment-update faults, failed user returns and truncated RIP need fences, clearing, retraining and repair.
Fatal on kernel-origin or external legacy events, unaligned image, oversize site, bad feature or width, undecodable bytes; SGX rejects bad leaf or nonzero reserved; vector 128 checks ISR.

invariants.text: Entry stashes address-space identity then switches early, saves speculation after segments usable; exit restores speculation, address space, then segments; paranoid exit never returns to user.
SYSENTER flags are sanitized before interrupts can enable; nested-task, alignment-check or trap set diverts to fixed image load, keeping single-step predictable.
32-bit fast path presets result, forces landing IP, marks compat, narrows number, clamps index, requires landing IP plus user selectors plus clear resume/trap/VM, fails safe to slow path.
Each 64-bit family bounds-checks, clamps index, stores result; extended family subtracts base bit, honors config gate, reports miss as not-implemented.
Bad FRED events halt from kernel level and report from user level; completion seals system slots to spurious and latches setup; KVM exit restores frame or issues kernel return.
Fixup rejects debug traps, scans for IP match and redirects with trap state; image needs clock count and page alignment; vdso32 boot value clamped to 0-1 with sysctl.
Robust unlock uses locked compare-exchange with width-sized pop clear; ChaCha processes 64-byte blocks with twenty rounds, advances counter, clears vector state.
Patch sites coalesce by address, validate feature, copy orig or replacement with call rewrite and NOP fill, bias relocations, narrow jumps, fatal on bad width or oversize.
Outermost NMI seeds stable copy, marks active each iteration, refreshes mutable copy outside forbidden window, unwinds in paranoid order, sets direction before clearing active.

locks.text: Fast 32-bit path enables interrupts across user access and dispatch, disables before exit on fault; robust unlock relies only on hardware locked op, no sleepable lock.

state_machines.text: With modern segment instructions base is always saved/restored; else sign probe decides swap with fences. Kernel faults match return and segment-update sites for fixup or swap.
Nesting checks repetition window first, then active flag, then stack bounds plus direction; user stack at syscall entry counts as outermost; nested arrivals rewrite mutable copy and return.
FRED routes by type: external via system or device path, hardware by vector with page-fault fast path, software only breakpoint/overflow, other for syscalls, else invalid.
64-bit dispatch tries native then extended tables before exit work and gated fast return; SGX validates leaf and reserved words with re-entry; patching scans start to end.

structs.text: NMI stack holds return context, scratch, active flag, mutable and stable copies plus regs; KVM frame is eight slots totaling 64 bytes; compat pushes segs, SP, flags, IP, number, regs.
System handlers live in array indexed by vector minus first system vector, prefilled with error, timer, scheduling and other vectors, installable only pre-setup into empty slots.
Privilege sits in low two bits of saved CS; all-set marker means no restart; selectors separate kernel/user; FRED other subcodes are one for 64-bit and two for 32-bit.
Extable entry holds insn and fixup relatives resolved against mapped base; VDSO_DEFAULT is 0 or 1 by variant, vdso64 defaults 1, fake 32-bit build fixes levels, offsets and cpu count.
